The '''Thyrian Ocean''' was a large body of water between the continents of [[Thyr]] and [[Masara]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. In the days of the [[Je'daii Order]], [[Cloud Chaser]]s were used to ferry travelers across the ocean.<ref name="Into the Void" />
